## What changes

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List commands and results. For model changes, include public data provenance, split checks, and evaluation settings.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass for the affected behavior.
- [ ] Documentation describes the actual API and limitations.
- [ ] No credentials, confidential inputs, downloaded datasets, or generated caches are included.
- [ ] Applicable software, model, and upstream attribution terms are preserved.
